messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that translates Java code to Python 3 code. The code should reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<translated_code>
import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.read().split()[0] + " "
    ans = 0
    start = 0
    i = 1
    while i < len(s):
        if s[i] != s[start]:
            if ((i - start) & 1) == 0:
                ans += 1
            start = i
        i += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
